common_limitations: Build identity: the runs used base commit bcad82de plus the uncommitted wave-5 working tree, bound by the digests in build_commit; the records describe that tree, not a commit. Once it is committed the native runs should be repeated at that commit (ADR-0007 §12.31 item 5).
Status discipline (m02-plan, M01 rule E15): verified rows mean the required tests ran and passed on that platform in this run; not an independent review of the units.

Linux and Windows binaries are cross-built on the macOS host with zig and run natively on the hosts; tests that read the repository at its compile-time path run on the build host only (case-index.json build_host_paths): a platform-neutral one counts as run elsewhere, any other keeps its row in_progress (harness gap). On Linux this leaves every corpus comparison against the host client's ssh -G (integration_sshconf_vs_ssh_g corpus_*, bom_and_crlf_acceptance, include_state_is_restored_after_included_file) unrun.

Two tests read compile-time paths but are not yet in build_host_paths, so they failed on Linux for that reason: heimdall-unit tui::view::tests::the_refusal_is_visible_in_the_modal (snapshot file decision_apply_refused_40x12) and e2e_cli_m02 unix::uninstall_purge_state_is_refused_without_a_typed_yes_and_keeps_everything (schemas/public-api).

The e2e pseudo-terminal cases (e2e_cli_m02 and e2e_run_m02) start their child with a cleared environment, so the child loses HEIMDALL_E2E_BIN and execs the build host's CARGO_BIN_EXE_heimdall path; off the build host they fail with 'exec failed: No such file or directory' (Linux run). A test-harness defect, escalated; those Linux rows stay in_progress.
Proptest regression files resolve at compile-time source paths: persisted regression seeds replay on macOS only; the fixed default seeds run everywhere.

Every fixture is disposable: per-run keys, the loopback fixture sshd, disposable ssh-agents with a scratch HOME, scratch configuration; the owners' keys, agents, ~/.ssh and Git configuration are never test material (m02-plan §0; ADR-0007 §9).

Redaction: the build host's name is three characters long, so the macOS harness's host-name redaction also rewrote parts of ordinary words in macos/ (the os= fact in host.txt and some crate and selftest names read '<host>'); over-redaction only. run-windows.sh stopped before its build-log redaction when the host was unreachable; windows/build.txt was redacted afterwards with the same m02_redact helper (build host home, user, TMPDIR) by M02-W5-run.

A01.summary: Existing access and repository-free use: no remote change, no key export, no mandatory prefix, unaffected aliases keep their behaviour, a personal profile without a repository; ordinary ssh, git, scp and sftp without -F in the disposable WSL distribution.

A11.summary: Ordinary access first-class; non-interactive use returns explicit interaction or capability state, without a popup or an unapproved fallback (fresh eligibility, fallback clearance, F23 confirm constraint).

A21.summary: The default doctor runs no executable, provider contact, signing, network or mutation; explicit probes are classified and bounded. executed_config_commands is 'constructs found before execution', never complete; config_tree_changed compares two observed snapshots.

A22.summary: Relevant behaviour correct, dynamic unknowns stay unknown, unrelated content and newer edits survive, generation deterministic: parser/evaluator corpus against each client's ssh -G, the projection transaction (commit points, recovery, quarantine, Git name transitions), setup admission.

A27.summary: No stdout contamination or shell injection; child streams and status preserved; setup failure distinguishable (prelaunch_failed, indeterminate); Windows pseudoconsole Ctrl-C and resize.

A35.summary: Verified executable and identity used; exact limitations; existing-auth not second-class: real disposable ssh-agent x ssh, git, scp, sftp x ordinary alias and run-bound.

R-RT-05.summary: No blind replay: run retries never relaunch, attempted applies are reconciled and never reapplied, recovery is idempotent.

ADR-0006-13.20-3.summary: ADR-0006 §13.20 item 3: every real-adapter call is bounded; a hung preparation's cleanup runs without a restart (R-RT-04).

R-SE-04.summary: Host trust is never weakened: render refuses host-verification directives; a substituted host key fails closed and nothing is written to known_hosts.

T06.summary: Clean local uninstall: user bytes and effective configuration restored, remaining items reported; incomplete rollback keeps artifacts and purge refuses; the disposable WSL distribution with a real home.

A participant can connect without a mand.summary: plan §5 M02 exit: a participant connects with ordinary ssh and no mandatory work wrapper (scripted in the disposable WSL distribution; the human walkthrough is owner input B7).

No remote authentication change, key exp.summary: plan §5 M02 exit: no remote authentication change, key export or provider-policy bypass was needed.
